actors.name: Veldt Solar executive team
actors.private_context: The executive team consists of the CEO, CFO, and head of product. They will decide at the quarterly review whether to shelve or greenlight the balcony-panel pilot. The head of product champions the pilot; the CFO wants engineers reallocated to the utility-scale line; the CEO has stayed publicly neutral.

actors.name: Pilot team
actors.private_context: The pilot team is awaiting the executive decision on the balcony-panel pilot. They are aware of the 400-unit sales against a 1,000-unit target, strong reviews, and thin margins.

shared_context: The balcony-panel pilot sold 400 units against a 1,000-unit target with strong reviews but thin margins. The quarterly review is scheduled for the week of 2026-10-05. The executive team will decide whether to shelve or greenlight the pilot and communicate the decision to the pilot team.

starting_events.description: The quarterly review begins with the executive team discussing the balcony-panel pilot.

resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that the executive team formally communicated a decision (either shelve or greenlight) to the pilot team before 2026-10-16T18:00:00+02:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
